reason: On $40k with a shift-work household, $15 a kid every visit adds up fast, and CoCo's Funhouse already does the job for less. I'd maybe use the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay after that.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I can't see why it's worth $15 a kid plus coffee I didn't ask for when we can do free playdates at church or the park.
would_change_my_mind: A real moms-group rate that makes it around $5 a kid, or a free Group Morning trial for my whole group so I could see it is actually better.
